items.content:
Earlier gameplay summary (agent-written, uncertain claims remain uncertain):
CONTROLS (from Keyboard options, verified): Z=Jump, X=Attack, C=Sprint/dash, A=Bind, I=Inventory, M=Map/inventory, Q=Crest, Tab=Quick Map (opens Inventory, no map overlay), S=Harpoon, D=Needolin, F=Skill/Tool, V=Challenge, J=Journal, T=Tasks (also inventory), Escape=Pause (Continue/Options/Quit), Return=confirm. Menu navigated with arrow keys; mouse clicks do NOT select menu items. No dedicated interact key exists. Inventory contents: Needle, Hunter's Cloak, crest slot, Shell Shards 4/400; HUD = 5 masks, silk spool, needle/currency icons. Early game: no tools, no double jump.

LOCATION CHAIN (observed): Starting green wheel room (large ornate woven cage/wheel with bulbous handle on right, decorative) -> left along mossy path/ledges -> green bell room (big mossy room, large woven bell/sphere ornaments, tall black mushrooms; some mushroom caps standable) -> teal/dark-teal caverns (mossy boulders, waterfall shafts, stone-brick "spine" arc bands) -> waterfall/overhang corridors -> bright/vibrant and lush green chambers containing pale, dark and rare GOLDEN woven spheres (all decorative; golden one once had a wooden chock) -> spool room (giant yarn spool with knitting needles + wooden stick, scenery) -> pushing Down+Right at spool room's bottom-right corner triggered a transition into a dark seated horned-shell/statue cave (stone perch, dark pillars on right) -> striking the horned statue yielded Shell Shards (+1 then total 4). Another transition (drop/Down+Left from statue cave ledge) reached a lower lush chamber containing a mosaic-patterned woven orb. Stone paths/cobblestone strips run along bottoms of most rooms; camera scroll confirms movement; several bottom-right corner edge pushes (Right+Down / Down+Right) have triggered new-area transitions.

OBSERVED MECHANICS: mushroom caps are standable in some rooms (not others); glare/glow motes and floating ovals/cocoons are ambient, NOT collectible (strikes scatter them, no pickup); Bind (A) does not heal or activate benches (may only heal missing masks); no pogo bounce off mushrooms (Down+X airborne), no wall-cling/wall-jump, no double jump (second Z), no drop-through floors (Down), no updraft in light shafts/waterfalls, no map overlay. "Transitions" often occur at bottom-right screen edges.

FAILED STRATEGIES (all inert on every woven sphere/bell, pale/dark/golden, and wooden chocks/stakes): plain point-blank X strikes, charged/long X, jump-attacks aimed at golden acorn/ball knobs from below and at apex, downward strikes, dash impacts (C), dash+attack (C+X), harpoon (S) at knobs (line fires but no hook), Needolin (D) short and sustained 2s, tool throw (F), Bind (A) short/long, pointer left/right clicks, jumping onto orb surfaces/rims, moving Right+Down repeatedly at right walls, climbing stone-brick pillars/wells/lattice towers (decorative), striking mossy wall/structure/vine curtains (some only scatter leaves). Also failed: reaching upper ceilings/ledges by chaining jumps on left mossy terraces, mushroom caps, or mushroom-top height in many rooms.

ACTIVE GOALS / LEADS (unresolved): (1) Dark stone-framed cave opening near a stone column at the upper-left of the STARTING green/wheel room's lower level — seen very early, never actually entered; repeatedly intended but never reached. (2) In the horned-statue shell cave, the stone-brick bench/ledge / dim upper-right stone-brick arch above the right pillars was never reached; plan was to mount the seated statue's head (previously done once) then jump up-right onto it; an unresolved dark lower area behind the right pillars (motives glowed) was never entered. (3) Terrain beyond bottom-right edges of orb rooms repeatedly blocked by decorative spheres.

UNCERTAINTY/GUESSES (not confirmed): room color tints may or may not mean distinct rooms; all woven orbs may become interactive only with an unavailable future tool; the map is believed fully looped horizontally at current abilities but this is inference, not confirmed; benches/checkpoints may exist but none found; the dark opening near the stone column is presumed the intended exit (guess). Exact positions of the dark opening and bench ledge relative to current position are uncertain; known route back: spool room's bottom-right edge (Down+Right) re-triggers the seated-horned-statue cave.
